definition: כְּבָרָה noun feminine a sieve (a net -like implement), Amos 9:9 כַּאֲשֶׁר יִנּוֺעַ בַּכְּבָרָה as it (corn) is shaken (i.e. sifted) in a sieve. compare Wetzst ZPV xiv. 1 ff .
